<subject>Coordination with Port Hedland Operations</subject>
<body>
I had a conversation with Bryan Wilson and Cynthia Calhoun this morning re: TRR-Logistics and the Port Hedland Operations process.

Bryan has generated both an in-the-money and out-of-the-money list of rail capacity allocations which he will forward so that Mine Planning can review for counterparty termination accuracy. I think that Port Hedland Operations can use our newly established processes as a template. Bryan and others will participate in the 9:30 a.m. conference call on 5 February.

John and Randy: Can you provide Bryan with a copy of the "Pilbara Rail Access" template, or if this has been replaced, a copy of the most recent template? Also, the "Australasian Bulk Handlers" template?

Kyle: Can you provide Bryan and Meredith Green with a copy of the decision tree and settlement process flowchart for rail allocation disputes?

If the handouts for tomorrow will be ready and incorporate the above, the handouts are all that Port Hedland Operations will need.

Thanks. SS

Katrina Howell
Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd
Counsel
1400 Railway Parade, Room 26B43
Perth, WA 6000
Ph: +61 8 0011 5961
Fax: +61 8 1532 2555
</body>
